name: – Tomas Tobé – After § 48 – Am 39
title: REPORT on the findings and recommendations of the Special Committee on the European Democracy Shield
part_text: 48a. Notes that fact-checking organisations receiving EU funding may be called upon to assess claims concerning the institutions financing them; calls for full disclosure of their public and private funding, governance and methodologies, and for safeguards ensuring their political, financial and editorial independence;
